stock.description: True Partner Capital Holding Limited is an asset management firm with a presence in both Hong Kong and Chicago. The company leverages its proprietary trading platform to actively manage diverse investment funds and provide discretionary managed accounts. Beyond its core fund management activities, the firm offers a range of services including investment advisory, business consultancy, general management support, software licensing, educational seminars, and comprehensive software development and support. Its extensive clientele includes collective investment schemes, family offices, pension and endowment funds, other financial institutions, and high-net-worth individuals. Established in 2010, the company's primary operational base is located in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong.
